bio: Why not treat yourself to a wonderful Afternoon Tea in the heart of Birmingham at Caffe Concerto - Birmingham?  Their Afternoon Tea is a classic interpretation of the British tradition consisting of delicate finger sandwiches with sumptuous fillings, freshly baked raisin and plain scones, alongside a delicious assortment of pastries and cakes. Guests feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of prosecco.  This Caffe Concerto site is situated in right in the heart of Birmingham's New Street Station and Bull Ring Shopping Centre.
